M2 section.admission: Draw adapters retain indexed arguments, declaration and current shader. The normal replay admits terrain or M2 vertex family 3. Buffered draws can share inputs independently of material admission. UP carries its own draw memory and retains the material guard.
M2 section.fallback: Re-read through the normal capture path on a stale bank or mesh proof. Unknown families stay on native submission. The 12340 native section in queued dispatch is diagnostic evidence, separate from the working D3D capture handoff.

ADT.admission: Recognized terrain with a buffered indexed draw and active material capture gives the world capture the first chance to publish PositionBounds. Other draws retain the ordinary material, normals and world order. World capture and ModelNormals share known camera rows from the device mirror under the draw gate. The sampled native audit certifies the prepared ADT range against its Gx submission, then checks that its native bounds cover MCVT heights and submitted positions.
ADT.fallback: Absent bounds use the existing material range path. Unsupported normal or material admission keeps native geometry and allows screen normals from depth/scene.

WMO group.admission: Resident map groups can supply static geometry with material cutouts. Live replay admission independently checks the captured shader, geometry, depth/blend and alpha state. Cache ownership and a successful current static submission determine exclusion from duplicate live replay. The sampled native audit associates the prepared range with the submitting WMO group and its local bounds.
WMO group.fallback: When cache ownership is unproven, eligible live packets remain in the replay set. Unsupported native draws continue through the game draw.

Water.admission: Registered client water shaders with matching main scene depth, viewport and draw state can publish positive view distance.
Water.fallback: Use the private second draw when the patched MRT is refused. If capture or resolve cannot publish, consumers use ordinary scene depth.

Weather.admission: World weather follows observed native draws and proven weather context. Menu precipitation and optional lens effects obey the menu profile, visibility and shelter gates.
Weather.fallback: Unsupported rain MRT state preserves the native draw. Absent precipitation, an indoor camera or failed supplemental resources can skip optics.

Sky.admission: Sky viewport band, main target, material role and current camera decide whether native sky layers, an owned disc or aurora emission can be captured.
Sky.fallback: Unproven sky ownership keeps the native artwork. Failed optional HDR foreground work preserves the ordinary scene and restores draw state.

Particles.admission: Recognized native draw and proven target, shader and blend mode can supply effect coverage or use an HDR output epilogue.
Particles.fallback: Unsupported effects retain the native submit. The compositor can run without auxiliary coverage.

UI.admission: A proven main-target UI boundary finishes the world HDR frame before ordinary interface draws.
UI.fallback: Offscreen or unproven UI retains the original native route. HDR can finish at Present if no earlier boundary is proven.

AO-only.admission: Contact AO is requested with world lighting, fog and local lighting inactive.
AO-only.fallback: The AO method and optional actor path are configured independently. Folded HDR requires base compositor admission; otherwise retain the standard composite.

fog-only.admission: Fog requires receiver distance while world lighting does not require normals or temporal light.
fog-only.fallback: Imported atmosphere may select the atlas instead of this raymarch route. Changing the distance producer invalidates the incompatible history.

Menu.admission: A supported lit menu model establishes camera/depth and a recognized menu atmosphere profile.
Menu.fallback: Without menu scene proof, keep eligible screen effects. Supplemental precipitation requires active weather and exposure.

2x MSAA.admission: Main color/depth share the active sample type and quality. Post-effect consumers use single-sample exports.
2x MSAA.fallback: Admitted water can use compact distance plus coverage, the legacy auxiliary MRT or the second draw. Native normal seeding requires its own sample compatibility.

shared-draw.shape: CPU draw-local mesh, vertex declaration, pose and constant bank
shared-draw.lifetime: CaptureSource retains the declaration for the draw. Consumers copy or retain queued inputs before it expires. Mesh aliases require range, declaration and version proofs. A bank needs matching write generation and covered register span.

native-scene.shape: Full-resolution color snapshot in the game target format, single sample
native-scene.lifetime: Device owns scene/sceneSurface. It publishes current color after the resolve and releases effect targets on Reset or size/format change.

native-world-depth.shape: Current game depth/stencil attachment at the world sample count
native-world-depth.lifetime: Device holds the proven main-world surface and depth range for the frame. Temporary targets and failed signatures cannot become the source for scene, water or rain capture.

native-scene-color.shape: Game color target at the active scene sample count
native-scene-color.lifetime: Original scene draws and admitted celestial work precede the Device color snapshot. World effects consume the resolved scene rather than sampling the attached target.

scene-depth.shape: Full-resolution single-sample INTZ, or DF24 on the supported 1x DXVK path
scene-depth.lifetime: Device owns depthTex. RESZ reads the held current world depth surface. At 2x MSAA the INTZ snapshot is the sampled input. The Device clears captured each frame and releases depthTex on Reset/resize.

model-normals.shape: Full-resolution RGBA16F, view normal XYZ and distance W, single sample
model-normals.lifetime: Model normals owns normal/surface plus a private D24S8. It publishes current contents after capture finish. The WorldRenderer holds a borrowed texture for the composite call.

material-detail.shape: Full-resolution RGBA16F height/detail target, single sample
material-detail.lifetime: AutoBump owns height/target. The getter admits current drawn content and WorldRenderer borrows it for this frame.

material-occlusion.lifetime: AutoBump owns occlusionMap/occlusionTarget. The getter requires a current occlusion draw.

world-normals.shape: Half-resolution RGBA16F, world normal XYZ and confidence W, single sample
world-normals.lifetime: NorthlightWorldNormalsPass retains the target across frames and overwrites it during the normals draw. Reset, resize or trim releases the target. The distance attachment is borrowed from lighting history.

current-distance.lifetime: NorthlightWorldLightHistory owns the texture and surface. WorldNormals RT1, TemporalLight RT1 or fog-only WorldDistance RT0 produces the current distance. The pair advances after a successful resolve.

previous-distance.shape: Previous half-resolution R32F from the same ping-pong pair
previous-distance.lifetime: The history owner validates map, camera and lighting domain. Fog reprojects from the previous slot after the distance pair advances.

directional-light.lifetime: NorthlightWorldScreenLighting owns this directional and GI target. Local lighting borrows the allocation after the last temporal read.

baseline-light.lifetime: NorthlightWorldScreenLighting owns this target. The first directional source writes RT1 and later consumers read the result from s12.

prelit-daylight.lifetime: NorthlightWorldScreenLighting allocates this optional target for stencil-selected rooms. The directional and GI passes write its current irradiance. Without a current result, the compositor binds neutral zero.

smoothed-light.lifetime: RemovalSmooth borrows the fog screen scratch before fog. The temporal shader can sample raw light instead; the merged path removes before resolving history.

temporal-light.lifetime: NorthlightWorldLightHistory publishes the resolved light slot for world composition. Local fog can borrow the old light image after its history reads.

previous-light.shape: Previous half-resolution RGBA16F in the other ping-pong slot
previous-light.lifetime: Previous lighting, bilinear reprojection. Rejected history gets no weight. References stop at the prior frame.

lighting-probes.shape: World GI atlas, metadata, previous atlas and visibility banks
lighting-probes.lifetime: Published GI resources are independently ready. Neutral/analytic fallback stays available during streaming.

static-caster-mesh.shape: Resident ADT and WMO map batches and qualified static M2 instances
static-caster-mesh.lifetime: World mesh and static caster owners publish committed VB/IB and draw ranges. Cache exclusion requires matching map, range/material and a ready shadow generation.

live-terrain-casters.shape: Current ADT vertices and a dynamic INDEX32 slice
live-terrain-casters.lifetime: NorthlightLiveTerrainIndices owns the index buffer and publishes the slice base after Unlock. The directional, flash and point passes borrow that slice under the shared frame EVENT. A directional alias or point face subset must match its originating generation and ranges.

shadow-replay-packets.shape: Geometry and draw ranges, declaration, captured program, pose constants, bounds and alpha state
shadow-replay-packets.lifetime: Capture and replay retain draw inputs for the current caster set. The patched vertex program preserves original deformation before reprojecting to light space. Pose and alpha equivalence gate grouping. Map/device invalidation retires stale references.

caster-alpha.shape: Captured or authored material texture and matching cutoff/alpha test
caster-alpha.lifetime: Binds only for caster paths requiring coverage. A native fixed-alpha replay scopes the compatible color/depth target and preserves the original texture and alpha test.

cascade-static.shape: Four 1280x1280 R32F targets with a shared single-sample D24S8
cascade-static.lifetime: NorthlightWorldDirectionalTargets owns two cached cascades per celestial source. WorldRenderer schedules refresh and reuse using the map generation, static commits and projection offset.

cascade-dynamic.shape: 1024x1024 R32F dynamic scratch or retained per-cascade transition target
cascade-dynamic.lifetime: NorthlightWorldDirectionalTargets reuses scratch for one cascade at a time. During an admitted fade, the slot uses a separate dynamic allocation. Both paths pair with single-sample D24S8.

cascade-history.shape: Optional 1024x1024 R32F previous static-only depth per transitioning cascade
cascade-history.lifetime: WorldRenderer retains previous static projection and depth. A fade reuses current moving casters and cancels on failed publication, invalidation or target trim.

cascade-near-environment.shape: Optional 1024x1024 R32F near depth per celestial source
cascade-near-environment.lifetime: The directional target owner keeps the union of static and live terrain before replay. Reuse requires the near environment key and current static publication.

neutral-shadow.lifetime: NorthlightWorldScreenFallbacks owns the white texture borrowed by shadow and fog passes. History copy binds it on s0 so only static depth reaches the retained slot. The shadow reset releases it.

cascade-near.shape: 1024x1024 R32F final near depth per source, single sample
cascade-near.lifetime: The directional target owner holds the near slot. The near-environment split combines static and terrain in a reusable intermediate before adding current replays.

cascade-far.shape: 1024x1024 R32F final far depth per source, single sample
cascade-far.lifetime: The directional target owner holds the far slot. Its validity follows the source, committed projection and static/dynamic refresh.

actor-shadow-depth.shape: 1024x1024 R32F depth per eligible celestial source, single sample
actor-shadow-depth.lifetime: NorthlightWorldActorShadows owns the targets; WorldRenderer redirects eligible near-cascade replays to each map using the directional D24S8. Actor validity and projection govern readers.

actor-tiles-mid.lifetime: NorthlightWorldActorShadows reuses this scratch for each source after its final reduction consumes the intermediate.

actor-tiles.shape: 64x64 R32F minimum-depth tiles per source, single sample
actor-tiles.lifetime: ActorTiles or the wider fog-aware second step writes the per-source texture. Readers require the current actor projection.

actor-visibility.shape: Half-resolution A8R8G8B8, sun R and moon G, single sample
actor-visibility.lifetime: Separate actor resolve publishes the mask for ordinary lighting. A successful shared resolve supplies both visibilities separately in directional-visibility.

directional-visibility.lifetime: NorthlightWorldDirectionalVisibility owns the optional target and shader pairs. The target clears before soft, shared or transition draws and is sampled only after a successful resolve.

point-static-face.shape: Up to six 256x256 R32F 2D textures per light, single sample
point-static-face.lifetime: PointCubeCache retains faces and their generation keys; invalid cache faces can be rebuilt within the frame budget. Eviction and reset release texture and surface aliases.

flash-near-map.shape: 1024x1024 R32F color depth, up to two source slots
flash-near-map.lifetime: Flash owner allocates on demand, invalidates readiness per frame and releases on geometry trim and Reset.

flash-far-map.shape: 1024x1024 R32F color depth, up to two source slots
flash-far-map.lifetime: Shares the near map's publication and resource lifetime.

point-dynamic-face.shape: Shared 256x256 R32F scratch with single-sample D24S8
point-dynamic-face.lifetime: Borrowed for one face. The min-blend or copied-static path can draw dynamic casters directly into the cube instead.

point-cube.shape: Six 256x256 R32F render-target faces per selected light, single sample
point-cube.lifetime: NorthlightWorldPointTargets owns the slots. Each slot holds its cube and COM face aliases. Consumers use a committed source and projection. An incomplete rebuild cannot publish a partially updated cube.

local-light.lifetime: Borrows the raw target from NorthlightWorldScreenLighting after TemporalLight. Composite uses neutral zero where no local draw ran.

screen-ao-raw.shape: Half-resolution RGBA16F, RGB bounce or contact bloom and alpha AO
screen-ao-raw.lifetime: Device owns aoRaw/aoRawSurface. Contact AO writes it and AOBlur samples the same allocation on s0 and s2 before restoring the scene binding.

screen-ao.shape: Half-resolution RGBA16F AO and pre-weighted contact bloom
screen-ao.lifetime: Device owns ao/aoSurface. AOBlur, ContactBloom or a neutral clear writes it. The world binds it to s10 for removal and composition or uses its neutral texture. The legacy composite can materialize the neutral clear late.

actor-ao-mask.shape: Screen coverage derived from reserved scene stencil bit 0x40
actor-ao-mask.lifetime: NorthlightAOActorStencil exposes current coverage only for the matching depth surface. A missing mask or optional shader leaves regular contact AO available.

actor-ao-guide.lifetime: AOActorPrepare temporarily writes the blur destination. AO samples this alias on s2, then releases it before AOBlur overwrites it with screen-ao.

water-compact-distance.shape: Full-resolution R32F view distance, with a matching multisample RT1 when admitted
water-compact-distance.lifetime: NorthlightWaterDistanceMask owns the single-sample texture and optional multisample twin. Direct single-sample reads, coverage correction and mixed merges share this storage.

water-compact-coverage.shape: L8 full-resolution coverage, with a matching multisample RT2
water-compact-coverage.lifetime: Exists for the compact MSAA route. Resolve may restrict the L8 copy to the written region while keeping the full R32F resolve.

water-legacy-mrt.shape: Legacy G32R32F distance and coverage with optional matching multisample twin
water-legacy-mrt.lifetime: Water renderer decodes the resolved input once into the private mask. Native end and effect boundaries release auxiliary target bindings.

water-mask.shape: Full-resolution single-sample water distance, R32F compact or G32R32F legacy/fallback
water-mask.lifetime: Current depth range and a successful capture or resolve gate visibility. Nonpositive distance uses the scene endpoint. Device lends the mask to AO, fog and celestial effects.

weather-state.shape: Frame weather kind, blend and intensity with exposure/shelter and mode
weather-state.lifetime: Updates from recognized native observations and applicable overrides. Menu uses its own profile. The current weather state drives atmospheric settings and optional optics.

weather-roof.lifetime: SurfaceRenderer updates it with the current weather roof snapshot. Release/reset drops the cache.

weather-art.shape: Managed L8 frost, precipitation and noise textures
weather-art.lifetime: SurfaceRenderer loads the embedded art on demand and reuses textures across frames.

weather-lens-scene.shape: Frame scene-copy texture in native SDR or linear HDR storage
weather-lens-scene.lifetime: Borrowed from existing scene storage. Lens optics copies the current output only when it will draw and samples the disjoint texture.

late-weather-color.shape: Weather contribution on the current SDR target or HDR presentation target
late-weather-color.lifetime: Supplemental precipitation and lens optics run after deferred effects under saved state with optional name stencil.

rain-native-texture.lifetime: The original draw owns the texture and diffuse inputs. The mask shader may replace exactly the supported fixed-function modulation.

rain-depth-snapshot.shape: Full-resolution single-sample depth snapshot at the first admitted rain draw
rain-depth-snapshot.lifetime: Device uses the known world depth and invalidates the snapshot each frame. Final depth comparisons remove later occlusions.

rain-mask-raw.shape: A8R8G8B8 coverage in alpha, optional matching multisample RT1
rain-mask-raw.lifetime: Rain draws accumulate the auxiliary alpha mask under supported MRT blending. The MSAA path resolves the twin before scrub.

rain-mask.shape: Current coverage in the red channel of A8R8G8B8
rain-mask.lifetime: RainScrub preserves source alpha while writing the red visibility bit to the same allocation. Final composition samples s13 and then restores regional fog.

effect-coverage.lifetime: Bound by the Device/WorldRenderer immediately before final composition; guards pixels with native effects already in the scene.

dither-tile.lifetime: NorthlightWorldScreenFallbacks owns the managed blue-noise tile and releases it with the screen targets. SDR s2 wraps. HDR binds its scene base on s2.

fog-regional-field.shape: Managed regional height and density texture with ground, extinction and layer height
fog-regional-field.lifetime: WorldRenderer publishes the texture for the current fog field identity. s13 is rebound from regional fog to rain mask only for final composition.

fog-height-bounds.lifetime: WorldRenderer binds the optional current height bounds on s12. Without matching height data the raymarch uses the general interval path.

fog-direct-floor.shape: RGBA32F with four direct-fog floor corners per regional cell
fog-direct-floor.lifetime: Managed moon-floor texture follows the uploaded field and map. The optional draw requires a current far moon cascade and compatible shader resources.

fog-cloud-noise.lifetime: WorldRenderer admits the asynchronously prepared noise on demand. Quiet imported variants can run while the texture is unavailable.

fog-volume-raw.shape: RGBA16F atlas of 64 cells along each depth column
fog-volume-raw.lifetime: NorthlightFogVolume writes coefficients into raw() for the current imported atmosphere. Atlas dimensions are eight times the cell-grid width and height.

fog-volume-history.shape: Resolved coefficients in the same three-atlas pool
fog-volume-history.lifetime: Zero temporal weight promotes the raw atlas without a draw. Otherwise VolumeTemporal writes a disjoint atlas and rotates history after success.

fog-volume-previous.shape: Previous coefficient atlas in the same pool
fog-volume-previous.lifetime: Read only with valid imported volume history and matching field. Current screen depth participates later in VolumeResolve.

fog-volume-prefix.shape: RGBA16F accumulated radiance and transmittance in the atlas pool
fog-volume-prefix.lifetime: Seven alternating prefix draws leave a retained result. An unchanged, settled atmosphere can reuse the committed result.

fog-raw.shape: Half-resolution RGBA16F atmospheric radiance and transmittance
fog-raw.lifetime: Raymarch or atlas resolve writes the raw NorthlightFogScreen image, with the optional companion cloud or regional pass. Local lamp glow is added after the screen filters.

fog-previous.lifetime: The previous texture is read only with a usable history weight. Inactive fog initializes neutral history and invalid mode or camera transitions reject temporal weight.

fog-current-history.lifetime: FogTemporal writes scratch then rotates the image pair into history. Blur reads the current history, and the next frame treats it as previous.

fog-horizontal.lifetime: Uses the raw allocation after the history swap, or scratch on the non-temporal path. The vertical pass consumes it immediately.

fog-lamp-accum.lifetime: The just-retired temporal light slot holds additive lamp radiance only after temporal lighting reads complete. Clear and combine are scoped to the union of affected rectangles.

fog-color.lifetime: Vertical blur publishes fog or fogBlurred, then optional local fog adds to the same surface. Compose uses neutral fog if the pass is unavailable.

hdr-linear-base.shape: Full-resolution RGBA16F working scene, or native UNORM sampled as sRGB in the inline route
hdr-linear-base.lifetime: HDR frame owns the prepared linear texture; the Device can pass the existing scene texture for the proven encoded base.

hdr-sky.shape: Full-resolution linear sky residual, with optional MSAA twin
hdr-sky.lifetime: Owned celestial or aurora emission writes linear headroom. Admitted native foreground attenuates it. The Device resolves and consumes it only with valid captured sky.

sky-layer-color.shape: Full-resolution RGBA16F sky layer capture, with optional MSAA twin
sky-layer-color.lifetime: NorthlightSkyComposition captures admitted native layers against the current scene target. Retains coverage across temporary offscreen work, invalidates on replacement or failed replay.

sky-background-copy.shape: Full-resolution native color snapshot before foreground
sky-background-copy.lifetime: The temporary copy uses sceneSurface before the main scene snapshot overwrites it. It supplies the early background draw only.

sky-background-optional-depth.shape: Optional sampled depth attachment for the background shader
sky-background-optional-depth.lifetime: The production Device passes null at s0 and leaves c10.w zero. The live attachment supplies hardware depth and per-sample rejection.

sky-native-layer-textures.shape: Native sky texture stages 0 and 1 and material role
sky-native-layer-textures.lifetime: These inputs belong to the current client draw. Capture and HDR foreground variants require supported native state and restore it after replay.

celestial-disc-art.shape: Managed A8R8G8B8 sun and moon textures
celestial-disc-art.lifetime: Celestial renderer owns the generated or loaded art and leases only the selected body texture for the current draw.

celestial-terrain-mask.lifetime: Optional terrain occlusion is valid for the current camera/body. Missing terrain proof leaves depth-based occlusion available.

celestial-halo-previous.shape: Previous 1x1 RGBA16F visibility per body and ring
celestial-halo-previous.lifetime: The halo and ring choose the previous slot independently and weight it only with valid history.

celestial-halo.lifetime: Admitted halo sampling publishes the next slot before drawing the disc or veil.

celestial-ring.lifetime: Late ring sampling writes its own next slot. Unavailable ring can bind the admitted halo fallback.

sky-fog-transmittance.shape: CPU scalar estimate of attenuation towards the sun
sky-fog-transmittance.lifetime: WorldRenderer updates it with the admitted fog/cloud profile; the SDR veil reads the current value.

composite-color.shape: Full-resolution SDR or linear HDR composite destination
composite-color.lifetime: NorthlightWorldComposite borrows the destination and owns the scratch result used by the standalone material pass. HDR may compose into the MSAA presentation target before HDR finishing.

composite-scratch.shape: Full-resolution scene format or RGBA16F for HDR, single sample
composite-scratch.lifetime: NorthlightWorldComposite owns the texture and surface. The ordinary composite writes it when a separate material draw follows. The renderer can also use it for the legacy scene copy.

hdr-exposure.lifetime: HDR frame owns the metering ping-pong; final output samples the current history index.

hdr-bloom.shape: Reduced-resolution HDR bloom or neutral texture
hdr-bloom.lifetime: HDR frame owns bloom allocations and reads the current selected base, wide or neutral product at finish.

hdr-present.shape: Full-resolution scRGB RGBA16F, output swap-chain sample count
hdr-present.lifetime: Device/OutputChain owns hdrPresentBack. Finish publishes world color before deferred effects and UI. Reset/output change releases the surface.

terrain-layer-textures.shape: Terrain alpha and generated normal texture inputs
terrain-layer-textures.lifetime: Material capture chooses textures for the recognized draw. Dynamic patched shaders retain validated original sampler bindings.

native-normal-seed.lifetime: Copies resolved current depth for eligible deferred model-normal captures; unsupported seed keeps the normal fallback.

writes.shared-draw: Only published when the current draw supplies proof

draw-handoff.fallback: A shared snapshot miss leaves the normal consumer's existing read path available. Draw ordering and the UP guard stay with the original adapters.

scene-inputs.fallback: Invalid projection, viewport or failed resolve blocks the screen-effects route.

entries.BumpNormalTerrainOpaque: Terrain normal/capture variant for the opaque domain
entries.BumpNormalTerrainLayer: Terrain normal/capture variant with layer mask

material-capture.fallback: Unknown or absent capture preserves the native draw; a missing texture reaches WorldRenderer as null.

entries.ModelNormalDepthSeed: Optional depth seed on the deferred capture path

writes.native-normal-seed: Private depth-stencil; not a world-depth write

normal-depth-seed.fallback: If the seed is unavailable, retain the selective replay path.

entries.ModelNormalCapture: Native PS patch template for alpha-tested normals
entries.ModelNormalOpaque: Native PS patch template for opaque normals

writes.model-normals: Native MRT with a compatible target or deferred/replayed geometry

model-normals.fallback: Unsupported target samples, pair or draw retain the original submission and replay; no model output lets the world reconstruct normals from scene data.

entries.AOActorPrepare: Eligible high-quality HBAO+ or GTAO frame with a current actor mask

writes.actor-ao-guide: RT0 borrowed from the denoised AO destination

ao-actor-prepare.fallback: If the optional mask or shaders are unavailable, skip the preparation draw.

entries.AO: Legacy SDR bounce, with an alpha replacement draw for an enabled alternate method
entries.AOContactBloom: SSAO with folded SDR contact bloom
entries.HBAOActorOnly: HBAO+ alpha-only with the actor guide
entries.GTAOActorOnly: GTAO alpha-only with the actor guide
entries.HBAOActorContactBloom: HBAO+ and bloom with the actor guide
entries.GTAOActorContactBloom: GTAO and bloom with the actor guide
entries.ContactBloom: AO disabled with a ready SDR bloom input

writes.screen-ao: RT0 with ContactBloom or a standalone neutral clear

contact-ao.fallback: Folded HDR with ContactAO disabled uses the world's neutral texture. A failed world composite clears the legacy AO target before using it.

entries.AOBlur: Bilateral blur with water depth support
entries.AOBlurNoWater: Optional blur when the current water mask is absent

writes.screen-ao: RT0 denoised result on the actor guide allocation

contact-ao-blur.fallback: Use the normal blur if the specialization is unavailable. Target or draw failure exits through the Device's saved-state boundary.

entries.WorldNormals: Lighting needs smoothed normals; RT1 is bound only when directional removal needs distance early. Also used if the optional one-output shader fails.
entries.WorldNormalsNoDistance: Lighting without an early distance producer; optional shader admission

world-normals.fallback: Missing model capture reconstructs from depth/scene; optional no-distance shader failure retains WorldNormals with RT1 detached.

entries.WorldDistance: Fog-only or another distance demand while lighting is inactive

writes.current-distance: RT0 when requirements.distance and lighting is inactive

fog-distance.fallback: Absent distance demand skips the write. Reentering lighting revalidates the history domain.

writes.static-caster-mesh: Resident terrain, world model and proven static instance ranges

static-caster-geometry.fallback: Static caster submission can fall back to ordinary instances. Only current, successfully covered ranges may suppress a live shadow packet.

shadow-caster-admission.owner: WorldRenderer draw capture and replay preparation

writes.shadow-replay-packets: Admitted caster geometry and captured pose
writes.caster-alpha: Proven texture and material cutout state

shadow-caster-admission.fallback: Unknown bounds keep eligible draws in the conservative caster set. Incompatible pose, range or coverage prevents grouping. The native draw remains independent of replay admission.

entries.StaticCasterInstancedVS: Prepared instance groups with two supported streams
entries.StaticCasterOpaquePS: Optional opaque depth without cutout sampler

writes.cascade-static: RT0; whole map or certified dirty rectangles

cascade-static-depth.fallback: Optional fast/instanced variants retain general shaders. Restart or render full cache when dirty rectangles or incremental reuse cannot be proved.

entries.ShadowPS: Dynamic terrain and cached-mesh fallback depth
entries.ShadowReplayPS: Directional replay depth with optional alpha sampling
entries.LocalPaletteShadowVS: Shared current-pose palette instancing for admitted opaque casters

writes.cascade-dynamic: RT0 scratch or the current dynamic transition target

cascade-live-depth.fallback: Keep unsupported grouping on ordinary draws. The fixed-alpha route scopes native coverage. Near replay only yields casters to the actor map when actor coverage is proven.

entries.ShadowUnion: Minimum of current replay/dynamic depth and projected static or retained near-environment depth

Depth.cascade-near-environment: Near slot with the terrain/environment split active

writes.cascade-near: RT0 near slot, with optional near-environment intermediate

cascade-union.fallback: Without near split use static cache plus current dynamic depth directly. Publication follows successful draw and checks the slot projection.

entries.ShadowUnion: Optional first near union, immediately after dynamic terrain and before actor replay

writes.cascade-near-environment: RT0; committed static plus current terrain

cascade-near-environment-union.fallback: Without a valid environment allocation and reuse key, render dynamic terrain and replays in the ordinary cascade scratch.

entries.ShadowUnion: Copy prior static depth into the fade slot; s0 is neutral white

writes.cascade-history: RT0 previous static depth projected into the retained slot

cascade-history-copy.fallback: Refused or failed history allocation keeps the ordinary no-fade shadow update.

entries.ShadowReplayPS: Replay packets redirected from the near cascade
entries.LocalPaletteShadowVS: Shared current-pose palette instancing for admitted opaque actor casters

writes.actor-shadow-depth: RT0 source slot with directional D24S8

actor-map-depth.fallback: Casters outside the actor inset or without the required coverage proof stay in the near map. Held bounds are used only under the actor hold contract.

actor-tiles-first.fallback: Skip when no current actor map is admitted.

entries.ActorTilesWide: Second step widens the footprint when the tiled fog range and optional shaders are ready

actor-tiles-final.fallback: Ordinary tile reduction when fog or extended shader admission fails.

entries.ActorShadow: Separate soft character filter when shared resolution is unavailable or fails

actor-visibility-resolve.fallback: A proven shared resolve replaces this mask. Without current actor inputs, ordinary lighting binds neutral white.

entries.UnifiedDirectionalShadow: Shared directional and actor resolve when maps and shader budget are ready and no transition is active
entries.DirectionalShadowTransitionCurrent: Current contribution during a live directional fade
entries.DirectionalShadowTransitionPrevious: Add previous static visibility with current dynamic casters on a fading source

writes.directional-visibility: RT0; RGBA16F with the selected source channel and shared actor/world route

cascade-visibility-resolve.fallback: Ordinary map sampling on soft resolve failure. Failed shared resolution restores the separate actor visibility mask. Failed transition resolution releases the optional history.

entries.LocalShadowVS: Static and uploaded point geometry transform
entries.LocalShadowPS: Range-limited point caster depth with optional cutout

writes.point-cube: RT0 direct min-blend or copied-static path with current dynamic casters

point-face-depth.fallback: Incompatible caster state uses per-packet replay. When direct blending/copy is unavailable use scratch and explicit union. Keep only a compatible committed cube on budget failure.

entries.ShadowUnion: Explicit point face min-union, or static-only copy when both samplers refer to the static face

Scene.point-static-face: Static-only copy passes the static face on both slots

writes.point-cube: RT0 face; consumers see the cube only after a successful publication

point-face-union.fallback: On supported direct min-blend or copied-static draws the explicit union can be bypassed.

writes.flash-near-map: First RT0 cascade with borrowed directional depth
writes.flash-far-map: Second RT0 cascade; both maps must finish before publication

flash-caster-depth.fallback: A missing current capture or incomplete map suppresses the optional shadow correction.

entries.FlashShadow: Subtract occluded radiance from the already lit receiver

writes.local-light: RT0 correction after the direct local-light pass

flash-shadow-correction.fallback: Retain direct flash light if the optional shadow pair is unavailable.

entries.LocalLighting: Additive local receiver with a committed point cube; ordinary filtering
entries.LocalLightingPcss: Optional PCSS receiver with the same cube and receiver inputs
entries.LocalFlash: Direct batch with a flash source and its current emission

writes.local-light: Additive half-resolution RT0 after directional temporal reads

world-local-lighting.fallback: PCSS shader failure retains ordinary filtering. Unshadowed batching and neutral local lighting remain available according to local admission and frame demand.

entries.WorldLightingUnshadowed: Directional shadows off and optional shader created
entries.WorldLightingUnshadowedGI: Last source on optional unshadowed fused GI route without packed cascade reads
entries.WorldGI: Separate GI for GI demand without fused GI

writes.directional-light: RT0; accumulates directional and admitted GI
writes.baseline-light: RT1 on the first directional source
writes.prelit-daylight: Optional RT2 during directional lighting and RT1 during separate GI

world-lighting.fallback: Optional shader or visibility failure retains the ordinary shader with appropriate masks. Incomplete probes retain the analytic ambient path.

entries.RemovalSmooth: Separate filter when removal is required and merged removal is unavailable or diagnostic capture needs the intermediate

writes.smoothed-light: RT0 borrowed from fogBlurred before fog

removal-smooth.fallback: Temporal reads raw light without removal, or performs removal in the merged route.

entries.TemporalLight: Standard temporal pass with smoothed or raw current light and a depth-gated GI crease filter
entries.TemporalLightMerged: Optional fused removal and temporal pass
entries.TemporalLightMergedZeroWeight: Optional backend route skips reads with zero weight

writes.current-distance: RT1 when WorldNormals did not write distance

temporal-light.fallback: Invalid history gets zero weight; optional fused creation refusal retains the separate filter and ordinary temporal pass.

entries.HdrDecodeWorld: Legacy-to-linear HDR base with optional captured sky and depth

writes.hdr-linear-base: Prepared float target; inline path instead shares native scene

hdr-decode.fallback: Inline sampling for a proven encoded base; failed ancillary HDR work falls back through Device HDR boundary handling.

fog-world-inputs.owner: NorthlightWorldFogField for regional textures, NorthlightRegionalFogGpu for cloud noise and NorthlightWorldMoonFloorFog for floor inputs

writes.fog-direct-floor: Same field's prepared moon floor corners
writes.sky-fog-transmittance: Current CPU atmospheric attenuation for the legacy veil

fog-world-inputs.fallback: Missing height support keeps the general interval. Noise or moon-floor failure uses the ordinary eligible fog path.

fog-raymarch.owner: NorthlightAtmosphereCommands and the selected fog shader owners

entries.WorldFogAmbient: God rays disabled or a provably ambient source
entries.WorldFogActorTiled: Regional with current actor depth and admitted tiles
entries.WorldFogActorTiledTransition: Directional fade with actor depth and tiles
entries.MoonFloorFog: Current far moon map and matching regional floor
entries.MoonFloorFogActorTransition: Moon floor fade with actor depth
entries.MoonFloorFogActorTiledTransition: Moon floor fade with actor tiles
entries.ForeverFog: Imported atmosphere raymarch when atlas unavailable
entries.ForeverFogActorNoNoise: Quiet imported raymarch with actor depth
entries.ForeverFogActorTiled: Imported tiled actor raymarch outside a fade
entries.ForeverFogTransition: Imported raymarch during a directional fade
entries.ForeverFogActorNoNoiseTransition: Quiet imported fade with actor depth

writes.fog-raw: RT0; first source writes transmittance, additional sources add RGB

fog-raymarch.fallback: Atlas refusal keeps the imported raymarch. Actor or tile refusal uses the applicable simpler shader, and optional moon-floor or quiet shader failure keeps the baseline route.

entries.FogClouds: Current cloud field and far visibility
entries.FogCloudsAmbient: Ambient cloud route with god rays off
entries.FogCloudsActorTiled: Clouds with usable current actor tile map
entries.FogCloudsTransition: Cloud fade over current and prior static cascades

writes.fog-raw: RT0 companion pass; respects the source blend order

fog-cloud-overlay.fallback: Inactive weather profile, refused noise or absent cloud shader skips the cloud overlay.

entries.VolumeInjectActor: Noisy imported source with actor depth
entries.VolumeInjectAmbient: Noisy ambient source while god rays are disabled

writes.fog-volume-raw: Atlas RT0; noisy route uses two samples per cell

fog-volume-inject.fallback: Insufficient size, shader slots or resource admission retains the imported raymarch. Unchanged settled input can skip injection.

writes.fog-volume-history: Disjoint atlas; zero weight promotes the raw allocation directly

fog-volume-temporal.fallback: A partially written integration sequence is invalidated before reuse.

entries.VolumePrefix: Initialize optical integral, then accumulate across six depth strides

VolumeInput.fog-volume-prefix: Subsequent scan steps read the prior step from the other scratch atlas

writes.fog-volume-prefix: Rotating scratch atlases; publish the last result only

fog-volume-prefix.fallback: A valid settled result is reusable until projection, lighting, field or noise conditions change.

entries.VolumeResolve: Sample the integrated volume at scene or water receiver depth

fog-volume-resolve.fallback: Missing atlas admission selects the direct raymarch before rendering.

entries.FogTemporal: Reproject and clamp the direct atmospheric path; imported atlas history is separate

writes.fog-current-history: Current fog after the successful texture and surface swap

fog-screen-temporal.fallback: Invalid reprojection gets zero weight. Inactive fog retains neutral history and the atlas path bypasses this pass.

FogBuffer.fog-current-history: When screen temporal published a current result

fog-blur-horizontal.fallback: Skip both blur draws for neutral fog.

entries.FogBlur: Vertical depth-aware blur reads the horizontal result

fog-blur-vertical.fallback: Neutral fog is available without running the blur.

entries.LocalFog: Analytic lamp glow with nonzero extinction and admitted scissor

writes.fog-lamp-accum: RT0 accumulates batches without using atmospheric history

fog-local-accumulate.fallback: Zero extinction or an entirely clipped set skips accumulation and combine.

entries.LocalFogCombine: Cap the sum once over the union, then add RGB to the filtered atmospheric target

writes.fog-color: In-place additive blend, with atmospheric alpha preserved

fog-local-combine.fallback: Without local fog, the filtered atmospheric target is final.

writes.water-compact-distance: RT1 on the proven compact path
writes.water-compact-coverage: RT2 on the compact multisampled path
writes.water-legacy-mrt: RT1 on the ordinary MRT route
writes.water-mask: Private second draw for the refused MRT route

water-draw.fallback: Patched client shaders require registration and known target/blend/fog state. Restore the original shaders and continue with a second draw on refusal.

writes.water-mask: Decode resolved legacy target, preserving valid private fallback pixels

water-legacy-resolve.fallback: A failed resolve does not publish MRT data. Consumers only accept a mask for the current depth range.

entries.WaterCorrectDistance: Normalize the compact averaged distance using resolved coverage and destination blending

writes.water-mask: Aliases compact distance. The single-sample path publishes it directly without a correction draw.

water-compact-correct.fallback: Failed correction cannot publish a compact result.

entries.WaterMergeDistanceMS: Merge resolved compact coverage and distance into the existing fallback image
entries.WaterMergeDistance: Merge single-sample compact distance into the fallback image

writes.water-mask: RT0 mixed mask; uncovered pixels keep the previous fallback draw

water-compact-merge.fallback: No compact correction or data is published after a failed mixed resolve.

writes.weather-state: Native draw evidence, resolved weather and profile inputs

native-weather.fallback: No admitted native texture or weather source leaves supplemental routes subject to current weather proof.

entries.RainMaskMRT: Supported stage-0 fixed-function rain with independent write masks and matching world targets

writes.rain-mask-raw: RT1 alpha coverage at the current sample count
writes.rain-depth-snapshot: RESZ snapshot before the first mask draw

rain-mask-capture.fallback: Target, state, caps and allocation refusal keep the native precipitation draw without the mask.

entries.RainScrub: Compare final scene depth against rain-time depth and write the red visibility bit

writes.rain-mask: RT0 red channel of the resolved alpha mask allocation

rain-mask-scrub.fallback: Skip publication if the twin resolve or scrub fails. World composition binds neutral zero.

writes.late-weather-color: Blended menu weather on the post-effect target

weather-menu-precipitation.fallback: World precipitation remains native. Inactive, sheltered or refused menu precipitation skips the supplemental draw.

entries.WeatherLensParticle: Dynamic rain drops, rivulets, flakes or sand particles

weather-lens.fallback: Exposure, strength, visible particles and available scene storage gate each branch. Failed optional optics leave the underlying frame.

writes.sky-layer-color: Scene-matched background and coverage, resolved from the optional multisample twin

sky-layer-capture.fallback: Native material or failed replay keeps authored sky. Temporary offscreen targets do not erase current main-sky coverage.

entries.CelestialSkyPS: Recompose sky before native foreground; menu can seed its sky via hardware depth

DiscSkyLayers.sky-background-copy: The admitted menu path can draw without captured layers

writes.sky-background-copy: Snapshot before foreground in reusable scene storage
writes.native-scene-color: Prepared background on the native target

sky-background.fallback: Invalid palette, camera or captured world layers retains the native sky.

entries.HdrSkyResidual-ps_2_0: SM2 epilogue for admitted linear residual coverage
entries.HdrSkyResidual-ps_3_0: SM3 epilogue for admitted residual coverage
entries.HdrFixedSky2: Fixed-function two-stage sky synthesis with admitted native target

writes.hdr-sky: Attenuate existing linear headroom by current native foreground

hdr-sky-foreground.fallback: Skip replay with no owned emission. If MRT and replay cannot be admitted, preserve native color and reject the optional residual route as needed.

entries.AuroraLegacy-ps_2_0: Legacy emission epilogue on captured SM2 output
entries.AuroraLegacy-ps_3_0: Legacy emission epilogue on captured SM3 output
entries.AuroraLinear-ps_2_0: Linear residual emission epilogue on SM2 output
entries.AuroraLinear-ps_3_0: Linear residual emission epilogue on SM3 output

writes.native-scene-color: Optional native aurora emission, keeping original geometry
writes.hdr-sky: Optional linear residual from the same proved aurora batch

aurora-emission.fallback: Unproved batch, patch or resource keeps the native draw.

entries.CelestialTerrainVS: Project prepared terrain coverage from the camera
entries.CelestialTerrainPS: Write terrain silhouette to the active body mask

celestial-terrain.fallback: Missing terrain proof or target leaves scene-depth visibility available.

entries.CelestialHaloVisibilityPS: Update temporal point visibility for the disc halo or the late sun ring

celestial-visibility.fallback: Invalid history starts at current visibility. Failed optional visibility leaves the applicable simpler disc route.

celestial-disc.owner: NorthlightCelestialDisc native claim and captured sky background

entries.CelestialDiscPS: Admitted early or late sun/moon disc and glare

DiscRingVisibility.celestial-halo: Use the admitted halo when the ring is unavailable

writes.native-scene-color: Owned disc or composed sky on the appropriate native target

celestial-disc.fallback: Preserve native artwork on failed claim. Late discs use the available depth, water and terrain occlusion proofs.

entries.CelestialVeilPS: Late legacy SDR veil attenuated by the current atmospheric profile

writes.composite-color: Additive SDR veil after world composition

celestial-veil.fallback: Linear HDR keeps bloom as its halo route. Missing glare state suppresses the optional veil.

writes.effect-coverage: Optional native alpha and emission coverage associated with the current scene target

native-effect-coverage.fallback: Unknown blend or target uses the original submit and preserves neutral scene-effect inputs.

entries.HdrParticle-ps_2_0: SM2 transfer epilogue for a proven particle output
entries.HdrParticle-ps_3_0: SM3 transfer epilogue for a proven particle output

writes.hdr-present: Blend deferred particles onto the admitted output target

hdr-particle-transfer.fallback: Unknown particle family keeps the ordinary draw or existing legacy layer route.

writes.hdr-present: Late UI on the admitted presentation target

hdr-ui-transfer.fallback: Offscreen draws remain native. Unsupported direct transfer can use the existing legacy layer path.

entries.WorldProbeLamps: Developer SDR view of probe irradiance and current direct lamps
entries.WorldBaseCompositeHdr: Eligible HDR base when combined material, fog and local light are absent
entries.WorldMaterialCompositeHdr: Combined HDR material/world route with enough PS3 slots, ready material and no diagnostic capture
entries.WorldUnlitComposite: SDR overlay for stencil-selected unlit receivers
entries.WorldUnlitCompositeHdr: HDR overlay for stencil-selected unlit receivers
entries.WorldPrelitComposite: SDR overlay for stencil-selected room daylight levels
entries.WorldPrelitCompositeHdr: HDR overlay for stencil-selected room daylight levels
entries.MaterialCompositeHdr: Separate HDR material pass when combined composition is unavailable or disabled
entries.MaterialSolarComposite: Separate SDR material pass with direct sunlight glints on depth-matched opaque terrain or WMO
entries.MaterialSolarCompositeHdr: Separate HDR material pass with direct sunlight glints on depth-matched opaque terrain or WMO

writes.composite-scratch: RT0 for the ordinary composite when standalone material follows

world-composite.fallback: Specialized variants fall back to full HDR, and missing optional inputs use neutral textures. A refused overlay shader leaves the ordinary composite active. Device can fall back to legacy composition.

entries.HdrWorldLinear: Output writer when a legacy destination is retained

writes.hdr-present: Composed output before UI, overlay and Present

hdr-output.fallback: HDR activation and finish failures are handled by the Device and the backend keeps the original presentation path.
